Agencies may request from OMB an extension of up to one year for a particular use of AI that cannot feasibly meet the minimum requirements by December 1, 2024. Extension requests must be submitted prior to October 15, 2024, and must include a detailed justification for why compliance cannot be achieved and a plan for how the agency will implement the required minimum practices.

For waivers, an agency Chief AI Officer (CAIO), in coordination with relevant officials, may waive one or more requirements for a specific covered AI application or component after making a written determination based on a system-specific and context-specific risk assessment. The CAIO must centrally track these waivers, reassess them if there are significant changes in conditions or context, and report to OMB within 30 days of granting or revoking any waiver, detailing the scope, justification, and supporting evidence.
